name: confbox
reason: Not counted: copy of the selected parser behind a thin wrapper. confbox 0.3.2 parseYAML(text) strips a BOM, calls load() from dist/_chunks/libs/js-yaml.mjs and records indentation for stringifyYAML. That chunk is a rolldown-minified copy of js-yaml 5.x built from its js-yaml ^5.5.0 devDependency (THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES lists js-yaml): all 195 property names in the chunk occur in js-yaml 5.5.0 dist/js-yaml.mjs, and the 5.x-only identifiers implicitFirstChars, matchByTagPrefix and representTagName occur 21, 13 and 7 times, exactly as in js-yaml 5.5.0 and never in js-yaml 4.1.1. Both controls match the oracle in an exploratory run, but the whole parse is the selected js-yaml code (fgergo/mp3 byte-identical-fork precedent; the thin JSON.parse wrappers of the JavaScript JSON cell are likewise not counted). The integrator may instead count it as a labelled wrapper.
